info.title: On API v3.28
info.description:
On API is designed for database ingestion, providing ability to retrieve updates on-demand for television schedule data and related information. Gracenote recommends a maximum limit of 1000 across all endpoints except Lineups. The maximum allowable limit for the Lineups endpoint is 10. Additionally, please use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

**Note:** The On API returns XML responses. The JSON schema shown in this Explorer represents the data structure. For XML response examples and format details, see the [On API documentation](/video/on-api/about-the-on-api).

get.description: Get celebrity updates starting from specified updateId, or lookup metadata for specified celebrities.

parameters.name: updateId
parameters.description: Update token. Returns celebrities beginning with specified updateId, which is sequential numeric offset received in response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Batch size. Maximum number of celebrities to be returned by API. Use with updateId.

parameters.name: personId
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. Comma-separated list of personIds for celebrity data. Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

get.description: Defines terms managed (controlled) to simplify data indexing and searching.

parameters.name: updateId
parameters.description: Update token. Returns CV values beginning with specified updateId, which is sequential numeric offset received in response.

parameters.name: limit

get.description: Get lineup metadata updates starting from specified updateId, or lookup lineup metadata for specified lineup ID.

parameters.name: updateId
parameters.description: Lineups modified at or after updateId.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Batch size. Maximum number of lineups to be returned. Use with updateId. Maximum limit is 10.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. Accepts comma-separated list of Lineup Ids. Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

get.description: Get program metadata updates starting from specified updateId, or lookup program metadata for specified program id (tmsId).

parameters.name: updateId
parameters.description: Programs modified at or after updateId.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Batch size. Maximum number of programs to be returned. Use with updateId.

parameters.name: tmsId
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. 14-char format tmsID. Accepts comma-separated list of tmsIDs. Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

parameters.name: rootId
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups by rootId. Supports a single value only. Does not support a comma-separated list of IDs. Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

parameters.name: updateId

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: updateId

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Batch size. Maximum number of program availabilities to be returned, to be used in conjunction with updateId to specify batch size.

parameters.name: tmsId
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. 14-char format tmsId. Accepts comma-separated list of tmsIds. Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

get.description: Get program mapping updates from specified updateId, or lookup-specified program mappings (using programMappingId, tmsId, or providerId). You must be using Gracenote's VOD Program Services prior to receiving API delivery of mappings.

parameters.name: updateId

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: programMappingId

parameters.name: tmsId
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. 14-char tmsId format. Accepts comma-separated list of tmsIDs. Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

parameters.name: providerId
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. Customer-specific providerId for mappings assets. Accepts comma-separated list of providerIds. Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

get.description: Get television schedule data updates starting from specified updateId, or lookup metadata for specified source and date range.

parameters.name: updateId
parameters.description: Schedules modified at or after updateId.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Batch size. Maximum number of schedules (station-days) to be returned, to be used in conjunction with updateId to specify batch size.

parameters.name: prgSvcId
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. Accepts a comma-separated list of programming service IDs (prgSvcId). Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. Date in yyyy-mm-dd format. Results  include station days >= startDate (midnight UTC). Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. Date in yyyy-mm-dd format. Results include station days < endDate (midnight UTC). Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments

parameters.name: limit

parameters.name: prgSvcId

get.description: Get video descriptors hierarchical taxonomy updates organized by video descriptor types starting from specified updateId, or lookup video descriptors for specified type (typeId). The Video Descriptors feature is sold separately. Contact your Gracenote representative to get this feature.

parameters.name: updateId
parameters.description: Video descriptor types modified at or after updateId. Use with  limit parameter for handling batches of updated types

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Batch size. Maximum number of types to be returned. Use with updateId.

parameters.name: typeId
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. typeId in GNID format (Example: GNFMQH6ZGH1477N), provides all video descriptors that belong to the type. Accepts comma-separated list of IDs. Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

get.description: Get organization data, including conferences and associated teams.

parameters.name: updateId
parameters.description: Update token. Defaults to 0. Returns teams beginning with updateId, which is sequential numeric offset received in response

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: For non-batch lookups. Comma-separated list of organizationIds. If not specified, all organizations are included in response. Use Lookup calls for QA and troubleshooting purposes only. Gracenote does not support lookup APIs for Client production environments.

get.description: Get sports schedule updates starting from specified updateId. The SportsSchedules endpoint is a convenience endpoint designed to retrieve Gracenote On Sports event schedules, organized by LEAGUE/TOUR and date (event local date).

parameters.name: updateId
parameters.description: Update token. Defaults to 0. Returns sports schedules beginning with updateId, which is sequential numeric offset received in response.

parameters.description: Batch size. Maximum number of sports schedules to be returned by API. Use with updateId.
